package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for create_single_in_loop_instead_of_batches: GORM .Create(...) used inside loops with no visible CreateInBatches(...) path in the same function.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule252PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario252Positive(db *gorm.DB, names []string) error {
	for _, name := range names {
		item := Rule252PositiveRecord{Name: name}
		if err := db.Create(&item).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
